title: Steak quesadillas
ingredients: 2 cups leftover steak, chopped (or quickly sear 3/4 lb steak)
2 cups shredded cheese (Oaxaca, Monterey Jack, or cheddar)
steps: Scatter cheese and steak on 4 tortillas. Top with remaining tortillas.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet over medium until crisp and melted, flipping once.
Cut into wedges. Serve with salsa and sour cream.
